meta.title: 长亮灯还是闪光灯
meta.topic: 摄影 · 闪光灯与常亮灯

scenes.title_cn: 开场：闪光灯和长亮灯完全是两个级别的…
scenes.title_en: Opening: flash and continuous light are tw…
scenes.context: 闪光灯亮度远超长亮灯。
sentences: 其实闪光灯和长亮灯完全是两个级别的产品。
Flash and continuous light are two completely different classes of product.
two different classes（两个级别）
我们平时用的机顶灯，换算成相同的亮度，差不多相当于一万瓦以上的长亮灯。
Our everyday speedlight equals a 10,000-watt-plus continuous light at the same brightness.
10,000-watt equivalent（一万瓦当量）
闪光灯在亮度上完全可以秒杀长亮灯。
Flash crushes continuous light in output.
crushes（秒杀）
scenes.speak: Flash and continuous light are two completely different classes of product. Our everyday speedlight equals a 10,000-watt-plus continuous light at the same brightness. Flash crushes continuous light in output.

scenes.title_cn: 亮度选择原则：灯的亮度输出基本上遵循…
scenes.context: 按环境亮度选择灯的类型。
sentences: 灯的亮度输出基本上遵循着愈强则强、愈弱则弱的原则。
Light output roughly follows the match-your-environment principle.
match the environment（与环境匹配）
夜景里面一个小小的补光灯就够了。
At night, a small fill light is enough.
small fill light（小补光灯）
如果是外景阳光，那么唯一的选择就只有闪光灯了。
In outdoor sunlight, flash is the only option.
only option（唯一选择）
scenes.speak: Light output roughly follows the match-your-environment principle. At night, a small fill light is enough. In outdoor sunlight, flash is the only option.

scenes.title_cn: 长亮灯的优势：所见即所得，对新手补光…
scenes.title_en: Continuous light's strengths: what you see…
scenes.context: 长亮灯看得到，闪光灯用得起附件。
sentences: 长亮灯的优势是所见即所得，对新手补光很友好。
Continuous light's strength is WYSIWYG, friendly for beginners.
WYSIWYG（所见即所得）
如果是视频拍摄，长亮灯是唯一的选择。
For video shooting, continuous light is the only choice.
only choice for video（视频唯一选择）
闪光灯远超长亮灯的亮度，使它可以加各种光效附件。
Flash's far higher output lets it use all kinds of light modifiers.
light modifiers（光效附件）
长亮灯常常因为亮度不够，不太好用这些附件。
Continuous lights often can't use these modifiers due to low output.
can't afford the loss（亮度不够）
scenes.speak: Continuous light's strength is WYSIWYG, friendly for beginners. For video shooting, continuous light is the only choice. Flash's far higher output lets it use all kinds of light modifiers. Continuous lights often can't use these modifiers due to low output.

scenes.title_cn: 闪光灯的凝固性：闪光灯还有瞬间凝固性…
scenes.title_en: Flash's freeze power: flash has instant-fr…
scenes.context: 凝固性带来画质提升，但门槛是必经之路。
sentences: 闪光灯还有一个瞬间凝固性的特点，拍出的照片锐度和质感都会更好。
Flash has instant-freeze power, so photos are sharper and more textured.
instant freeze（瞬间凝固）
闪光灯的学习确实有点门槛，跨不过去你就会觉得用灯很难受。
Learning flash has a real hurdle—before crossing it, lighting feels miserable.
the learning hurdle（学习门槛）
你一旦过了这个门槛，玩灯可能是摄影里面最大的乐趣。
Once past it, playing with light may be photography's biggest joy.
biggest joy（最大乐趣）
scenes.speak: Flash has instant-freeze power, so photos are sharper and more textured. Learning flash has a real hurdle—before crossing it, lighting feels miserable. Once past it, playing with light may be photography's biggest joy.

scenes.title_cn: 色温调节：有人说长亮灯还可以无极调节…
scenes.title_en: Color temp: some say continuous light offe…
scenes.context: 色温调节的对比与预告。
sentences: 其实闪光灯加上绿色纸也可以调色温。
Flash can adjust color temp with gels too.
gels（色纸）
长亮灯具备冷暖两个灯珠，通过比例的混合无极调节色温更方便。
Continuous light has warm and cool LEDs, mixing by ratio for easier stepless control.
stepless control（无极调节）
scenes.speak: Flash can adjust color temp with gels too. Continuous light has warm and cool LEDs, mixing by ratio for easier stepless control.

practice: Flash and continuous light are different classes.
Match the lamp to the environment brightness.
Flash powers big modifiers like softboxes.
Flash freezes motion for sharper shots.
Flash can use gels, LED mixes warm and cool.
pitfalls: Use continuous light in bright sun.
Only flash can beat outdoor sunlight.
外景阳光只有闪光灯压得住。
Expect continuous light to power big modifiers.
Flash's output affords deep umbrellas and softboxes.
附件吃光严重，常亮灯亮度不够。
Give up on flash at the learning hurdle.
Push past it—playing with light is the biggest joy.
跨过门槛，玩灯是摄影最大乐趣。
Think continuous is better for stepless color temp.
Flash gets stepless color temp on a trigger too.
闪光灯在引闪器上也能无极调色温。
shifts: 用 flash（闪光灯）、continuous light（长亮灯）、speedlight（机顶灯）
用 output（输出）、10,000-watt equivalent（一万瓦当量）、match the environment（匹配环境）
用 instant freeze（瞬间凝固）、sharper（更锐利）、modifiers（光效附件）
